concept.subject: Two racks of tall wooden poles on a sand bar, each with a green net stretched over its top and dark netting hung down to the sand to dry, reflected in the calm shallows in front.
concept.composition: The left rack stands from a tenth to a little under half of the width, the right one from a little over half to nine tenths, their poles reaching from the sand bar at seven tenths of the height up to a quarter, the tallest at the racks' inner ends. A green net lies over each rack at two fifths of the height, sagging between its front poles, and dark netting drapes from it to the sand, spreading out on the left of each rack. The far beach is a thin strip at half height with a row of distant stakes in the sea on the left; below the sand bar the still water reflects the racks. The sky is clear, the top center open.
concept.layout: Round pegs only, 141. The green nets are peg lines sagging over the racks, single pegs mark the pole tips, the draped netting is a short peg line down to the sand beside each rack and sparse floats mark the nets' lower edges on the sand. The mesh is a lattice fill inside a traced area that covers both nets and the shallows where they are reflected, joined under the bottom edge; the far beach and the distant stakes are short peg rows.

difficulty.note: Second easiest: the even mesh lights pegs on almost any drop into it; the empty sky under the cannon leaves the nearest pegs on the pole tips and the nets, so the orange pegs spread over both racks and the shallows.

background.prompt: A photo of a calm, shallow beach. Two racks of tall, thin, leaning wooden poles stand on a pale sand bar: the left one from about a tenth to a little under half of the width, the right one from a little over half to about nine tenths, their tallest poles at the inner ends reaching up to about a quarter of the height. A green net is stretched over the top of each rack at about two fifths of the height, sagging between the front poles, and dark netting hangs from it to the sand, spreading out on the left of each rack. The sand bar crosses the picture from about three fifths to seven tenths of the height; behind it lie a thin strip of far beach and the sea at about half height, with a row of distant stakes in the water on the left. Below the sand bar, still shallow water reflects the poles and nets down to the bottom. The sky is clear and pale, open at the top center; the lower corners are plain water.

picture.title: Serene beach scene in Tokyo, Japan with fishing nets under a clear sky.
picture.author: Iban Lopez Luna
